Explain in 4 short sentences what discrete diffusion language models do.<turn|>
<|turn>model
<|channel>thought
<channel|>Discrete diffusion language models generate text by gradually transforming a sequence of random tokens into a coherent sentence or paragraph. During training, the model learns to reverse a process that systematically masks or replaces original words with noise. Unlike standard autoregressive models that predict text word-by-word, these models can refine the entire sequence simultaneously. This approach allows for more flexible generation patterns and better handling of global structure within the text.<eos>
